pins.title: What to Pack for a Weekend Getaway on Virginia's Northern Neck
pins.description: What to pack for a weekend getaway on Virginia's Northern Neck: polarized sunglasses, water shoes, binoculars, slip-ons for the sauna walk, and a swimsuit in any month.
pins.altText: Two stemless glasses of rosé on a wooden dock rail at dusk, with a still creek and dark tree line behind.
pins.keywordVariant: what to pack for a weekend getaway

pins.title: Packing List for a Chesapeake Bay Cottage Stay in Virginia
pins.description: A Chesapeake Bay cottage packing list from the hosts: a thin stinger suit for jellyfish season, water shoes for the oystery shallows, binoculars, and a few small extras.
pins.altText: A weathered wooden dock with pilings reaching out over calm, pale creek water in daylight.

pins.title: What to Bring to a Waterfront Cottage with a Sauna and Hot Tub
pins.description: Staying at a waterfront cottage with a cedar sauna and a year-round hot tub? Bring slip-on shoes for the walk, a swimsuit in any month, and a camera for the evening gold.
pins.altText: Top half: two glasses of rosé on a dock rail at dusk. Bottom half: a wooden dock extending over calm creek water.
pins.keywordVariant: what to bring to a cottage with a sauna and hot tub
